name: Storybook
summary: Find the stories for a component in your own running Storybook.
description: Find the stories for a component in your own running Storybook and get preview links. Available capabilities depend on the provider and the explicitly granted permissions.
about: Find the stories for a component in your own running Storybook and get preview links. Available capabilities depend on the provider and the explicitly granted permissions.
Connects to the MCP endpoint of @storybook/addon-mcp 10.6.6 (MIT) inside your own Storybook dev server on this computer. No account.
Windows fixture acceptance: an owned two-story component was found by file, both stories were previewed and rendered with their real label and disabled state, and an unknown story ID was refused.
Install the addon in your own project at the exact version; this recipe cannot pin your project's packages. Docs and test toolsets were not qualified.

mcp.name: storybook
reaches: only your Storybook dev server on 127.0.0.1:6006
guide: In your own project add storybook@10.6.6 and @storybook/addon-mcp@10.6.6 at exact versions, list the addon in .storybook/main, and run storybook dev -p 6006 --host 127.0.0.1.
Qualified: the dev toolset only (stories-find-by-component, stories-preview, get-storybook-story-instructions). Docs and test toolsets are not part of this recipe; keep them off in the addon options.
A client header can ask for other toolsets; that is not server-side authorization. Choose the addon toolsets in main, not in Sara.
Preview links point at your local Storybook. Open them only in a browser you trust with that project.
After discovery, open Settings → Coding → Tools and approvals. Set every tool in this server's group to Ask me first or Off before sending any request.
Save, leave and reopen the page; read back every tool setting. Repeat after restart, update or newly discovered tools. Stop if settings cannot be confirmed.

changes: First connection recipe. Fixture-qualified on Windows; not published.
